=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:4845-4847, 4878-4880 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: compose_synced_security_issue and compose_synced_security_occurrence publish the Release SHA, the Reporting audit run URL and the Heal intake run URL, which are outside the fields Q245 permits.
  WHY: Every accepted report writes these extra values to the public coding-workflows repository, and the audit run URL exposes a consumer run identifier, which breaks the BLOCKER Q245 disclosure limit. Both flaggers rated it BLOCKER (mapped to critical). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly disputed the finding: it says plan lines 81-82 require the reporting consumers and the run link, the run URL is regex- and repository-bounded, and the release SHA is checked with `is_valid_sha`.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Q245 BLOCKER: "The issue body, occurrence comments, logs and job summaries carry only file, line, category, severity, confidence, finding_id and the consumer repository. Never accept, store or publish `exploit_scenario`, `recommendation` or any other free text. Reject unknown keys in each finding."
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py — compose_synced_security_issue (its `parts` list) and compose_synced_security_occurrence (its `lines` list)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: compose_synced_security_issue at scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py around lines 4845-4847 emits "Release SHA", "Reporting audit run" (`_synced_security_run_url(payload)`) and "Heal intake run". compose_synced_security_occurrence around lines 4878-4880 emits the same three fields. The final `tg_send_msg` inside `_synced_security_finding_intake` in scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh (around line 898 of the new hunks) appends `${RUN_URL}`. test_issue_and_occurrence_carry_no_free_text at tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_synced_security.py:222 does not assert that the release SHA, consumer run URL or intake run URL are absent. The LAST RUN DIFF does not resolve the gap.
- requirement: For each finding whose file exactly matches the release's managed-digests list, run the existing dedupe, occurrence, budget, and open path; the plan also identifies retired consumer files as synced files in scope.
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py::synced_security_source_paths and scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh, the `open)` branch of `_synced_security_finding_intake`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: `build_sync_manifest.py` adds entries from `workflow-templates/retired_files.txt` to managed digests, including `.claude/commands/claude-issue-dispatch.md`. The source-path mapper maps `.claude/` files to `workflow-templates/.claude/...`, but that retired file has no such template. Scope rendering therefore produces no marker, and the intake skips the managed finding as `scope_unresolved` at `workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:819-825` instead of running the open path (severity MAJOR).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
(No findings reported.)
- HARDENING: File: `scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh`, Location: `_synced_security_finding_intake`, `escalate)` arm
  PROBLEM: The result of `gh issue edit ... --add-label "${ESCALATED_LABEL}" || true` is discarded, so the `escalate reason=lineage_cap` log line reads the same whether or not the label was applied.
  WHY: Suggested minimal fix: record the result of the edit and append `label=applied|failed` to the existing log line (estimated lines changed: 3). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
